answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bonded to a single vertex in a public trust graph. Reputation flows along edges like a vine, so a new identity inherits nothing until trusted neighbours vouch for it with their own stake at risk. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for each fake vertex, and the cost multiplies across the whole ocean of identities they try to control, making forgery more expensive than any reward it could win.
